entry.title: Η Κίνα επενδύει 295 δισ. δολ. για να κυριαρχήσει στην AI
entry.summary: China plans to spend about $295bn over five years on a national network of AI data centers, aiming to surpass the US. It will rely on domestic suppliers like Huawei for at least 80% of the technology, effectively shutting out Nvidia and AMD.

entry.title: Πρεμιέρα στη μάχη τού Συντάγματος
entry.summary: Parliament begins debating the formation of the Constitutional Revision Committee, with Makis Voridis set to chair it for New Democracy. In a charged, pre-electoral climate, no consensus is expected on the articles the majority will propose.

entry.title: ΕΛΣΤΑΤ: Στο 5,2% ο πληθωρισμός τον Μάιο
entry.summary: Inflation eased slightly to 5.2% in May from 5.4% in April, according to ELSTAT. Standout increases hit meat, rents (7.7%), fuel and energy, with heating oil up 53.2%.

entry.title: Ανοιχτοί δίαυλοι με τη Λιβύη
entry.summary: Deputy FM Alexandra Papadopoulou visited Tripoli for a second round of technical talks on delimiting Greek-Libyan maritime zones. Athens aims to keep channels open with both Libyan governments while tempering expectations of a breakthrough.

entry.title: Βουλή: Συγκροτήθηκε η Επιτροπή Αναθεώρησης του Συντάγματος
entry.summary: Parliament's plenary formally established the Constitutional Revision Committee following a proposal by the ND leader and 154 MPs. It set a two-month deadline, by majority vote, for the committee to submit its report.

entry.title: «Διαρροή» αργού από το Ορμούζ απέτρεψε ένα μεγάλο σοκ τιμών
entry.summary: Despite a three-month closure of the Strait of Hormuz amid the Iran war, oil prices have not spiked. JP Morgan estimates that 'invisible' tankers move up to 2.1m barrels a day, evading the blockade by switching off their transponders.

entry.title: Φιλιππίνες: Πλησιάζουν τους 50 οι νεκροί του μεγάλου σεισμού των 7,8 βαθμών [εικόνες]
entry.summary: The death toll from the magnitude 7.8 earthquake in the Philippines is nearing 50, with hundreds injured and crews searching for the missing. The quake struck off Mindanao, causing building collapses and landslides.

entry.title: Νέα έξοδος της Ελλάδας στις αγορές, με 10ετές ομόλογο
entry.summary: The Greek state is tapping markets with a re-issue of a 10-year bond maturing in 2036, two days before the ECB's first rate hike of the year. The aim is less to raise liquidity than to strengthen the Greek yield curve.

entry.title: Προστασία υποδομών από υβριδικές επιθέσεις
entry.summary: The government is advancing a national plan to protect critical infrastructure from hybrid and cyber threats, centered on energy. A new General Secretariat under the Citizen Protection ministry will coordinate it, fulfilling an EU obligation under the CER directive.

entry.title: Αποκάλυψη «Κ»: Καρέ καρέ η δράση του κυκλώματος στις πολεοδομίες
entry.summary: Exclusive Kathimerini photos shed light on a bribery and corruption ring in town-planning offices. According to the case file, officials took cash in envelopes and boxes of sweets to unblock permits and erase fines.

entry.title: Ερντογάν: Κλιμακώνει τη ρητορική για Ισραήλ και Κύπρο – «Κάποιοι προσπαθούν να πυροδοτήσουν διχόνοια στο νησί»
entry.summary: Turkish President Erdogan is escalating his rhetoric, claiming Israeli strikes on Syria and Lebanon threaten Turkey. He also warned of 'provocative, Israeli-led moves' in the Mediterranean and Cyprus.

entry.title: Νύχτα αντιμεταναστευτικής βίας στο Μπέλφαστ: Πυρπολήσεις σπιτιών και Ι.Χ. – «Φυλετικό πογκρόμ»
entry.summary: A night of anti-migrant violence gripped Belfast, with homes and cars torched, attacks on migrants and families fleeing. The unrest, sparked by the arrest of a Sudanese man over a stabbing, was described as a 'racial pogrom.'

entry.title: Υποκλοπές: Προς συνεδρίαση της Επιτροπής Θεσμών
entry.summary: The path opens for Tal Dilian and Grigoris Dimitriadis to be summoned before Parliament's Institutions and Transparency Committee over the wiretapping affair, after a SYRIZA request. The list also includes former intelligence chief P. Kontoleon.

entry.title: CNN: Οι νέοι ηγέτες του Ιράν ρισκάρουν περισσότερο από τους προκατόχους τους
entry.summary: A CNN analysis argues Iran's new leaders are pursuing a more aggressive, less restrained strategy, moving away from proxy conflicts. Recent attacks on Israel signal Tehran is redefining its 'rules of engagement.'

entry.title: Ιράν: ΗΠΑ και Ισραήλ υπονομεύουν τη διπλωματία
entry.summary: Middle East escalation continues, with Iran announcing that diplomacy with the US cannot proceed while the ceasefire is violated. Tehran accuses both the US and Israel of undermining diplomacy.

entry.title: Κυρ. Μητσοτάκης: Η Ευρώπη πρέπει να κινηθεί στην κατεύθυνση της έκθεσης Ντράγκι
entry.summary: In his talk with Amanpour, Mitsotakis argued that 'strength matters' in an era of geopolitical turbulence and that Greece has restored its credibility. He urged Europe to move in the direction of the Draghi report on competitiveness.

entry.title: Οι Συν-Ερευνητές της Τ.Ν. και ο ρόλος του ανθρώπου
entry.summary: The journal Nature unveiled two new AI systems, Google DeepMind's Co-Scientist and FutureHouse's Robin, acting as 'co-researchers.' They can formulate scientific hypotheses and analyze data, dramatically cutting the time to discovery.

entry.title: Τρεις στους δέκα εργοδότες σχεδιάζουν προσλήψεις το γ’ τρίμηνο
entry.summary: A ManpowerGroup survey shows a cooling labor market: only 3 in 10 employers plan to hire in Q3 2026. The net employment outlook index falls to 7%, well below the global average of 26%.

entry.title: Βρετανική κυβέρνηση κατά Μασκ: «Υποδαύλισε την ένταση πριν από τα επεισόδια στο Μπέλφαστ»
entry.summary: The British government sharply criticized Elon Musk, accusing him of inflaming tensions before the violent anti-migrant riots in Belfast. Hours before the unrest, Musk had posted on X a call for 'loud protests.'

entry.title: Ο Μακρόν θα προεδρεύσει τηλεδιάσκεψης G7 και Κίνας για τις παγκόσμιες εμπορικές ανισορροπίες
entry.summary: French President Macron will chair a video conference of the G7 and China on global trade imbalances. According to the French presidency, the initiative reflects a 'new willingness' by China, the US and Europe to coordinate economically.
